phases.goal: Bring the hands to opposite stable contact points on the wooden roller.
phases.name: approach_roller
phases.verify: Roller remains visible and centered between the hands.

phases.goal: Close or brace the hands around the roller.
phases.name: secure_roller
phases.verify: Roller moves with the hands or is visibly trapped without rolling away.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Both grippers approach the roller without pushing it away.
Roller is held or trapped stably before lifting.

roles.protected: roller remains on a reachable path between grippers

task_language: Hold the light brown wooden roller on the table with hands.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 4:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 5:move_to(arm=right,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 6:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid treating one-hand contact as a completed grasp; verify both hands secure the roller and relocalize it before correcting a slip.
